decision.summaryForCoordinator: ACCEPT. 23 attacks run, 22 refuted, 1 not sustained as a finding. 0 blockers, 0 MUST-FIX, 0 SHOULD-FIX. Four checks were decisive and all were run against live bytes rather than the artifact's account. First, the gate ceiling: file 08 holds 30 DR-G rows topping out at DR-G30, and DR-G31 and DR-G32 each occur ZERO times in file 08 and ZERO times in COORD — so neither is live, and the artifact says so and blocks its own recording behind notRecordableUntilG31Live. Second, the thirteen classes: namedThirteenClassesVerbatim is ORDERED-EQUAL to live actor-join v8 joinFixtureClasses.classes under exact list comparison, all 13 members byte-identical and in position, with the proposed harness cell's thirteen ids likewise ordered-equal; no fourteenth class exists and doctor FC implementations are correctly held off as OBL-DOCTOR-FX-AUTHORING. Third, path occupancy: I stat'ed the filesystem rather than trusting artifactExists false — the named path does not exist and no harness.DR-G32 file of any version exists. Fourth, owner provenance: 'Operability + security' matches the live DR-114 owner cell and the live DR-G12 owner cell exactly, and is pointedly NOT the DR-G09 owner 'Security', consistent with the artifact's central point that G09's live claim owns permission truth and not this property. Everything else holds: no SATISFIED across 10 contexts, no D-* number, gates 2 and 3 expressly denied for DR-114, FC-C1 / CA-2 / CA-1 IN_PROCESS all declined in negative-list fields, no D9 code or unit. All 14 recordedInputs and every cited digest clean; HEAD 5d5d778; required-now 26. One observation: the cardinality field pair 26 and 28 skips 27, which the adjacent condition-4 field states correctly.
